title: Penguin Bowling
tagline: Belly-slide a chubby penguin into wobbly snowmen and watch them tumble!
howToPlay: Swipe up from the penguin to send it whooshing down the ice (a curvy swipe curves it), or tap the big yellow slide button for a lucky-dip slide; ◀ ▶ move it, and it lines itself up with the pins left for the second slide. Five frames full of surprises (giant snowmen, golden pins, a cheeky pin that jumps the penguin, conga lines), strikes win hats you can pick on the title card, and 🏠, 🎵 and 🔊 need a short hold during play.
learning: Aiming, cause and effect, and a feel for the pins left standing
